question: What is the theme for National Forest Martyrs Day 2025 in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Remembering Martyrs, Protecting Forests**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The theme for National Forest Martyrs Day 2025 is “Remembering Martyrs, Protecting Forests” to honor those who sacrificed their lives to protect forests in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Forest Martyrs Day is observed every year on September 11 to honor the sacrifices made by individuals who protected India’s forests and biodiversity.**
 
• The day traces its roots to the Khejarli Massacre of 1730 in Rajasthan, where Amrita Devi Bishnoi and 363 villagers sacrificed their lives to protect Khejri trees from being felled.
 
• The day also commemorates the Chipko Movement, where villagers embraced trees to stop deforestation in the 1970s.
 
• In 2013, the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) declared September 11 as National Forest Martyrs Day to recognize these sacrifices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Khejarli Massacre (1730)__

 __
 
• Amrita Devi Bishnoi and 363 villagers gave their lives to prevent the king’s men from cutting down Khejri trees, which became a symbol of environmental defense.
 
 
 
• Chipko Movement (1970s)__
 __
 
• A grassroots movement where villagers embraced trees to prevent logging, inspired by the Khejarli sacrifice, advocating for forest conservation.
 
 
 
• Forest Guards and Modern Heroes__
 
 
• Forest guards and activists continue to protect forests, often sacrificing their lives in battles against poachers and illegal loggers.
